commands: set -euo pipefail; echo '=== git ==='; git status --short; git rev-parse HEAD

set -euo pipefail; echo '=== applications ==='; ls -la /Applications | grep -i kicad || true; find /Applications -maxdepth 6 -type f -name 'kicad-cli' -print 2>/dev/null | head -20; find /Applications -maxdepth 6 -type f -name 'pcbnew' -print 2>/dev/null | head -20

set -euo pipefail; echo '=== versions ==='; for p in /Applications/KiCad/KiCad.app/Contents/MacOS/kicad-cli /Applications/KiCad/KiCad.app/Contents/MacOS/kicad /Applications/KiCad/pcbnew.app/Contents/MacOS/pcbnew; do if test -x "$p"; then echo "--- $p"; "$p" --version 2>&1 || true; fi; done

set -euo pipefail; echo '=== shared support ==='; for d in /Applications/KiCad/KiCad.app/Contents/SharedSupport /Applications/KiCad/KiCad.app/Contents/SharedSupport/symbols /Applications/KiCad/KiCad.app/Contents/SharedSupport/footprints; do if test -e "$d"; then echo "--- $d"; ls -ld "$d"; fi; done; find /Applications/KiCad/KiCad.app/Contents/SharedSupport/symbols -maxdepth 1 -type f 2>/dev/null | head -10; find /Applications/KiCad/KiCad.app/Contents/SharedSupport/footprints -maxdepth 1 -type d 2>/dev/null | head -10

set -euo pipefail; echo '=== python pcbnew ==='; for py in /Applications/KiCad/KiCad.app/Contents/Frameworks/Python.framework/Versions/*/bin/python3 /Library/Frameworks/Python.framework/Versions/3.12/bin/python3; do if test -x "$py"; then echo "--- $py"; "$py" --version 2>&1 || true; "$py" -c 'import importlib.util; print("pcbnew", importlib.util.find_spec("pcbnew")); print("skidl", importlib.util.find_spec("skidl"))' 2>&1 || true; fi; done; echo '=== final status ==='; git status --short
